listing.description: A website for a laser-cutting shop or metal-décor studio. On the first screen a laser cuts an eight-point star in real time, prices sit in a spec sheet with thicknesses, and projects appear as backlit perforated panels.

seo.title: Your Company — laser metal cutting in Tashkent
seo.description: Laser cutting of steel, stainless and Corten to your drawings. Decorative panels, planters, signs and screens. A quote within an hour, production from one day.
seo.answer: Your Company is a laser-cutting shop at 7 Kichik Khalka Yuli Street, Tashkent. We cut steel up to 20 mm, stainless up to 10 mm and Corten from DXF drawings: cutting from 8,000 sum per metre, Corten panels from 1,800,000 sum per m², planters from 650,000 sum. Quotes arrive within an hour and simple parts are ready the next day.

sections.title: Metal cut exactly to drawing
sections.subtitle: Steel, stainless and Corten, from a single part to a batch. Send a DXF or a sketch: a quote within the hour, ready tomorrow.

sections.title: From drawing to metal in a day
sections.text: We run a 3 kW fibre laser, a press brake and a powder-coating booth, so parts never leave the shop. Designers and architects send files; we check them, suggest where to save metal and cut. For private clients we draw the pattern ourselves.

items.q: How much does laser cutting cost?
items.a: From 8,000 sum per metre of cut for 1–2 mm steel. The exact price depends on thickness, contour length and pierce count; send the file and we will price it within the hour.
DXF or DWG at 1:1 is best. PDF, SVG or even a photo of a sketch will do; we will draw it up ourselves.

items.q: What is Corten and why is it rusty?
items.a: It is weathering steel: a thin rust layer protects it from further corrosion, so it needs no paint. We accelerate the patina so the colour is even from day one.

items.q: Will you cut my own metal?
items.a: Yes, we cut customer-supplied sheet and charge only for the cutting. It must be flat and free of scale and oil.

items.q: Do you deliver to other cities?
items.a: Yes, we ship across Uzbekistan by courier companies; delivery within Tashkent starts at 100,000 sum.
